body:
Well here's to another idea which won't get considered..
Either way, the purpose of this would be to mention someone in a thread and they get notified for it. 

An example would be the 'Avicus ships' thread that's going on right now.
("I ship @Player1 with @Player2!!")... and it would notify each player.

Adding the feature would let you notify a person that you mentioned them in a comment in that thread so they don't miss out on it. 
Thoughts?

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
I think it's a cool but unneeded feature given the current state of Avicus. I think you all would prefer us to work on Atlas (already missed a rough deadline) or in game updates at the moment rather than taking several days dedicated to looking into, creating and testing this feature. We want to attract and retain players and the forums are really the last place to try and do that. When our priorities shift even slightly we can start to look into this and many others like this one.

Everyone is mad that developers don't respond here too, I'll touch on that. I actively look at big idea suggestions like discussions that try identifying issue areas in Avicus, ones that suggest interesting changes in the structure of the server, etc. I hear about little suggestions from the community like this one very often, several every week. If we were to address each and spend time thinking about their implementation and also responding, we would make less progress everywhere. We take many into account but prioritize crucial changes to the server first. I hope that's reasonable. Perhaps it would be an easy addition, then we could find some time to work on it, but you've gotta understand that this idea is one of literally hundreds.

Also, just because another server we know of got this feature doesn't mean we need it suddenly too... Ahem.
